.uma-brand { display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
.uma-brand-img { display: block; width: 168px; max-width: 54vw; height: auto; }
/* on the site the mark hangs over the blue bar at the top of the page and
   settles to bar height once you scroll. Scroll-driven animations only: the
   @supports guard keeps every other engine on the static 168px mark. */
@supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
  @keyframes uma-brand-shrink {
    from { width: 232px; max-width: 74vw; }
    to   { width: 168px; max-width: 54vw; }
  }
  .uma-brand-img {
    animation: uma-brand-shrink linear both;
    animation-timeline: scroll(root block);
    animation-range: 0 190px;
  }
}
.uma-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
/* the site's horseshoe: a ring with the middle of its base clipped away, which
   leaves the two legs and the gap. Same construction in the header and over the
   notifications slot, so the two marks match. */

  width: 22px; height: 22px; box-sizing: border-box;

/* ============================================================
   WHOLE-PROFILE SKIN
   Janitor's real page classes, lifted from the user's previous theme:
   .pp-page-background / .pp-uc-* (user card) / .pp-tabs-* / .pp-cc-* (cards)
   / .profile-top-bar-*. Styling these is what makes the theme cover the page
   instead of only the About Me block.
   ============================================================ */
.pp-page-background {
  background: #EAF3FF !important;
  overflow-x: clip !important;
}
/* Janitor wraps the About Me block in its own padded column. Zeroing the
   padding and letting the wrapper disappear (display:contents — the same trick
   the previous theme used) is what lets .uma-shell span the whole viewport. */
.pp-uc-background, .pp-uc-background > *,
.pp-uc-about-me, .profile-about-me {
  padding: 0 !important; margin-left: 0 !important; margin-right: 0 !important;
  max-width: none !important;
}

  .uma-media-tile { width: 48.6%; }
  .uma-card-thumb { width: 168px; }
}

/* Sections settle in as they arrive, so the page has some life as you scroll.
   Scroll-driven only, and only when the reader has not asked for less motion. */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  @keyframes uma-reveal {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .uma-sec > .uma-tag-wrap,
    .uma-sec > .uma-hl,
    .uma-sec > .uma-card,
    .uma-sec > .uma-more,
    .uma-sec > .uma-grid,
    .uma-sec > .uma-media-row,
    .uma-sec > .uma-explore {
      animation: uma-reveal linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% entry 60%;
    }
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .uma-shell *, .uma-shell *::before, .uma-shell *::after {
    animation-duration: .001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: .001ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}
